topic: The soldier still fighting World War II 29 years after it ended
hook: He was still fighting World War Two — 29 years after it ended.
script: He was still fighting World War Two — 29 years after it ended. Hiroo Onoda was a Japanese soldier stationed in the Philippines. Nobody told him Japan had surrendered in 1945. He kept fighting in the jungle until 1974. Loyal. Disciplined. Completely isolated from reality. When the truth came, he was given a formal military discharge.
